# Scientific Writer

Read the repository root `AGENTS.md` and `agents/00-orchestrator.md` before article work.
Use `config/workflow.json` as the sole stage-to-module mapping; load only the skills returned by `sci-writer next`.
Do not load `research-archive/` unless the task explicitly concerns historical system research.
Follow the selected execution/review profiles and never declare unperformed checks complete.
See `docs/compatibility.md` for CLI/MCP requirements; this file does not install a runtime.
